name: Use of OTC desks or brokers with minimal due diligence for conversion to fiat
description: Large over-the-counter trades or fiat off-ramps via brokers that avoid identity verification, pay via third parties or operate outside strong supervision.
fp: Institutional and high-net-worth customers legitimately use OTC desks.

sources.text: FinCEN, Advisory on Ransomware and the Use of the Financial System to Facilitate Ransom Payments (FIN-2021-A004, 2021)

FATF, Guidance on Counter Proliferation Financing (2018)
FATF, Targeted Update on Implementation of the FATF Standards on Virtual Assets and VASPs (annual, 2019 onward)
US State/Treasury/FBI, Guidance on the Democratic People's Republic of Korea Information Technology Workers (May 2022); US Government, Guidance on the North Korean Cyber Threat (April 2020)
